name: guesty-cli
what_it_holds: Independent Python CLI wrapping the Guesty PMS API with local sync of a connected account's listings/reservations to local files. No committed sample data; requires the operator's own Guesty credentials.
why_useful: Only relevant if the team can get read access to a real vacation-rental manager's Guesty account (e.g. through a contact) — would then give a clean local occupancy/ADR export mechanism.
themes: Property-management / channel-manager / PMS public data (Guesty, Hostaway, Lodgify, OwnerRez, Hostfully, Smoobu, Beds24, iCal feeds) and vacation-rental manager benchmarks
why_all: Only relevant if the team can get read access to a real vacation-rental manager's Guesty account (e.g. through a contact) — would then give a clean local occupancy/ADR export mechanism.

name: property-occupancy
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed TypeScript/npm package (11 commits, 3 stars) computing daily/monthly occupancy-rate percentages from a caller-supplied array of reservation {check-in, check-out} objects; mentions Airbnb/Booking.com/VRBO as target platforms but does not itself pull or integrate any listing/reservation data.
why_useful: Pure calculation utility, not a data source - would only be useful if paired with an actual VRBO reservation feed, which the team does not have. Cataloguing for completeness only.
themes: Vrbo / HomeAway datasets and scrapers, Vrbo listing snapshots, Expedia Group vacation rental supply data
why_all: Pure calculation utility, not a data source - would only be useful if paired with an actual VRBO reservation feed, which the team does not have. Cataloguing for completeness only.

name: zunda-pixel/tripadvisor-swift
what_it_holds: Swift library wrapping the official TripAdvisor Content API (requires an official API key); updated 2026-09-12.
why_useful: Confirms the official TripAdvisor Content API is still actively wrapped/maintained by third parties as a legitimate (non-scraping) data-acquisition path, though it needs an API key the team does not have.
size_hint: tool only, needs official API key
themes: TripAdvisor datasets: hotel/vacation-rental reviews, review velocity, TripAdvisor rentals, scraper repos
why_all: Confirms the official TripAdvisor Content API is still actively wrapped/maintained by third parties as a legitimate (non-scraping) data-acquisition path, though it needs an API key the team does not have.

name: MichiganNLP/multilingual_reviews_deception
what_it_holds: NAACL 2025 Findings paper repo, 'Multilingual Deception Detection of GPT-generated Hotel Reviews'. Committed `all_data.csv` labels real vs. GPT-4-generated hotel reviews (label 0 = real, 1 = fake/LLM-generated); generation code in LLM_generation.py; XLM-RoBERTa multilingual modeling. Source platform of the 'real' reviews not confirmed as TripAdvisor specifically in the fetched content. MIT licensed.
why_useful: Marginal for KPI forecasting, but relevant to a review-authenticity/fake-review-detection angle if the team ever wants to sanity-check whether a review-velocity signal (ours or a competitor's) is contaminated by synthetic reviews. Low priority for now.
themes: TripAdvisor datasets: hotel/vacation-rental reviews, review velocity, TripAdvisor rentals, scraper repos
why_all: Marginal for KPI forecasting, but relevant to a review-authenticity/fake-review-detection angle if the team ever wants to sanity-check whether a review-velocity signal (ours or a competitor's) is contaminated by synthetic reviews. Low priority for now.

name: occupancy_tax_payers_identifier
what_it_holds: Python + PostgreSQL toolkit (12 numbered scripts) to identify lodging providers with an occupancy-tax obligation within an administrative boundary by cross-referencing Facebook Place Search API, Google Places API, Foursquare Places API, Booking.com, TripAdvisor, and Airbnb.com, plus Eurostat tourism-data integration. No committed output dataset; author states proof-of-concept, no explicit license, scientific-use-only disclaimer. 23 commits.
why_useful: A method for cross-platform host/property identification tied to municipal occupancy-tax enforcement (gap #8/#9 supply enumeration); one of its six sources is airbnb.com directly, so running it is a terms-of-service decision per repo policy and is only catalogued, not run.
geography: generalizable, no specific cities in repo
themes: State and city hotel occupancy and lodging-tax datasets (Nevada, Florida tourist development tax, Texas hotel occupancy tax, California TOT, NYC hotel occupancy tax, Hawaii TAT)
Tourist tax and city-tax datasets: Paris taxe de sejour, Amsterdam toeristenbelasting, Italian imposta di soggiorno, Airbnb remittance reports, occupancy-tax remittance by platform
why_all: A method for cross-platform host/property identification tied to municipal occupancy-tax enforcement (gap #8/#9 supply enumeration); one of its six sources is airbnb.com directly, so running it is a terms-of-service decision per repo policy and is only catalogued, not run.

A working method (not sanctioned for us to run, per repo rules on non-Airbnb scraping decisions) for cross-checking STR supply density against tax-registration compliance in a given city; template for a compliance/coverage cross-check on municipal STR registries we already hold.
